name: WordPress v7
description: Initially started as a blogging tool in 2003, it has evolved into a highly flexible CMS that powers over 40% of the web. WordPress 7 requires MySQL 8.0 and is packaged as a new app alongside the legacy WordPress 6 entry.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Wordpress db password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the wordpress-v7 application
services:
  # Service definition for the main application
  app:
    # Docker image to use for the application
    image: wordpress:7.1.3@sha256:e5a724ec7ad9055f48b2941ac1b674b08e77ed60edb8937a6254fb89ec45ddf7
    # Port mapping for the application
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    # Environment variables for the application
    environment:
      WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db
      WORDPRESS_DB_USER: casaos
      WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      WORDPRESS_DB_NAME: wordpress
    # Volume mapping for the application
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/html:/var/www/html
    # Service dependencies for the application
    depends_on:
      - db
  # Service definition for the database
  db:
    # Docker image to use for the database
    image: mysql:8.0@sha256:7dcddc01f13bab2f15cde676d44d01f61fc9f99fe7785e86196dfc07d358ae2b
    # Environment variables for the database
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: wordpress
      MYSQL_USER: casaos
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD}
    # Volume mapping for the database
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
